key_insight: SrTiO3-xHx oxyhydrides strongly favor a cis O4H2 local anion arrangement, and capturing this ordering requires careful DFT+U calibration against HSE06.
engineering_relevance: Accurate anion-order predictions can guide oxyhydride design by linking local hydride placement to structural stability, migration energetics, and reducible Ti chemistry.
method: Built a cluster expansion for SrTiO3-xHx using HSE06 hybrid-DFT reference energetics.
Screened DFT+U sensitivity and identified U = 3.3 eV as the best proxy for HSE06 ordering energetics.
Used ground-state searches and Monte Carlo sampling to assess anion-ordering trends and stability.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports up to ~100 meV/anion variation across DFT+U choices and a ~200 meV per hydride stabilization for the cis O4H2 configuration.
watch_item: The ordering results depend strongly on the chosen U value, so transferable conclusions require explicit calibration to higher-level reference data.
paper_title: Long- and Short-Range Anion Order in SrTiO$_{3-x}$H$_x$ Perovskite Oxyhydrides: DFT+$U$ Sensitivity and HSE06 Cluster Expansion
